query:
MATCH p = ACYCLIC (s:player {id: $seed})-[:follow]->{1,3}(:player)
RETURN transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) AS node_ids;
notes: Uses the evaluator-selected Database graph and supplied STRING parameter $seed. ACYCLIC excludes repeated nodes; the outgoing follow quantifier admits 1 through 3 hops. nodes(p) plus transform preserves path node order and projects business id values. RETURN has no DISTINCT, so parallel-edge paths retain duplicate node_ids rows. References: SKILL.md; references/patterns.md path variable, quantifier and path type sections; references/documented-syntax.md path pattern grammar; references/documented-functions.md nodes() and transform(); references/functions.md lambda mapping; references/identifiers.md, checklist.md and applicable validation.md checks. Bundled quote-identifiers helper confirmed the generated identifiers are ordinary names. No database execution performed.
